mechanism: Valerian may have hepatotoxic potential and propylthiouracil carries inherent hepatotoxicity risk, creating additive liver injury potential; valerian may also have mild sedative effects that could mask symptoms of propylthiouracil-induced agranulocytosis.
action: Monitor liver function tests regularly; counsel patients on signs of hepatotoxicity and agranulocytosis; consider alternative anxiolytics if hepatic impairment develops.
